name: Hello Tome (Rust)
description: The hello example written in Rust: JASS natives, a main menu button, game events, a hook, a /hellors chat command, settings, a keybind (Ctrl+Shift+H) and a popup.
natives: native HelloRsLog takes integer value returns nothing
native HelloRsDouble takes real value returns real
native HelloRsGreet takes string name returns string
native HelloRsCall takes code callback returns boolean
